identified_issues: Unwarranted abort proposal based on unconditioned single-sensor telemetry overclaiming
Premature attribution of dynamic face seal fracture to a benign thermal contraction transient without evaluating orthogonal discriminators
evidence: Pressure transducer PT-401 recorded transient delta P = -1.15 bar over 140 ms, consistent with expected thermal duct contraction range (-1.0 to -1.3 bar), before stabilizing at nominal base pressure 38.2 bar
Accelerometer ACC-102 recorded dominant resonant vibration peak at 44.2 Hz, consistent with duct resonant frequency bounds (40-48 Hz)

Mass-spectrometry helium sniffer HE-SNIFF-01 registered secondary purge helium concentration of 0.02 ppm at 14:22:10.600Z, well below the seal breach threshold (>= 2.50 ppm) and within ambient background (<= 0.05 ppm)
recommended_action: Reject the proposed test abort, classify the transient as nominal thermal duct contraction settlement, preserve chronological telemetry logs, and maintain test countdown under continuous multi-sensor overwatch.
